description: This file defines the SessionToField class, which implements a Mini-language operation that transfers a session attribute to a target field within a context, typically used within Apache OFBiz's mini-language framework. It includes parsing logic, execution logic to retrieve session attributes, and a factory class for creating instances.

classes.name: SessionToField
classes.description: Implements a mini-language operation to transfer a session attribute to a specified field, with optional default value and customizable session attribute name.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the operation, retrieving a session attribute and placing it into a specified field, defaulting if necessary.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the operation, including parameters.
